senses.gloss: to prevent something bad from happening

senses.gloss: to turn your eyes or face away from something
senses.example: He averted his eyes during the accident scene.

translations.th_TH: เบือนสายตา

example_translations.zh_TW: 在事故現場那一幕中，他移開了視線。

example_translations.vi_VN: Anh ấy ngoảnh mắt đi trong cảnh tai nạn.
example_translations.th_TH: เขาเบือนสายตาไประหว่างฉากอุบัติเหตุ

definition_translations.zh_TW: 把目光或臉從某物移開

definition_translations.vi_VN: quay mắt hoặc mặt khỏi điều gì đó
